note: Roadhouse on County Road WW outside Wisconsin Rapids that serves a lightly breaded haddock, perch and walleye fish fry all day on Fridays.

name: Savory Steakhouse
note: Steakhouse-style supper club in the Kellner area south of Wisconsin Rapids with a Friday-night fry of catfish, haddock and bluegill.

name: The Branding Iron Supper Club
note: Northwoods-style supper club south of Wisconsin Rapids, dating to 1973 and run by new owners since 2024, with a Friday fish fry of cod, perch or shrimp.
